items.title: William Russell Interview, 1976-02-16
items.q: He was a cartoonist, you know.

ctx.x: How about E. Sims Campbell? Do you know anything about E. Sims Campbell? He wrote the chapter on blues. I've seen him once. I never did really know him.
He was around New York. He was a cartoonist, you know. I think he did sketches or things for Esquire for a while, and I hadn't heard anything about him for years either.

He was a black writer. Yeah. Yeah. Which leads to a question I have. All right. Well, what, are there any black critics or writers of jazz that you are particularly interested in? Or would you venture to say why you don't think more blacks have written about their own creations?
